title: Generic one-parameter families of 3-dimensional Filippov Systems
summary: This paper addresses openness, density and structural stability conditions of one-parameter families of 3D piecewise smooth vector fields (PSVFs) defined around typical singularities. Our treatment is local and the switching set, $M$, is a $2D$ surface embedded in $\mathbb{R}^3$. In short, we analyze the robustness and normal forms of certain codimension one singularities that occur in PSVFs.
